# UK NHS England Medical Exemption Certificate (FP92A)

> A digital implementation of the **FP92A** application form completed by a UK doctor (or other health professional with access to the patient's medical records) to apply for a **Medical Exemption (MedEx) Certificate** for NHS prescription charges in England.
